biography.ja: ロンドンに生まれ、リュート奏者・歌手として若くから才能を認められた。イングランド女王の宮廷音楽家の地位を望んだが得られず、大陸各地の宮廷を渡り歩いた末にデンマーク王の宮廷リュート奏者として長年仕えた。念願だったイングランド宮廷への出仕は晩年になってようやく実現した。
biography.en: Born in London, he was recognized as a talented lutenist and singer from a young age. He sought but failed to obtain a position as court musician to the Queen of England, and after traveling among various courts on the Continent he served for many years as court lutenist to the King of Denmark. His long-desired appointment to the English court was finally realized only in his later years.

style.ja: リュート伴奏歌曲の分野で、憂愁に満ちた深い感情表現を追求した作風を確立し、自らの名にちなんで「常にダウランド、常に嘆く」という標語を作品に記すほど、悲しみの表現を自らの様式の核に据えた。半音階的な和声の陰影を巧みに用い、歌詞の哀感を音楽に直結させる書法に長けていた。
style.en: In the field of lute-accompanied song he established a style pursuing deep, melancholic emotional expression, going so far as to inscribe works with a motto punning on his own name, "always Dowland, always mourning," placing the expression of sorrow at the very core of his style. He skillfully used shadings of chromatic harmony, adept at translating a text's pathos directly into music.

impact.ja: リュート歌曲というジャンルにおいて、イギリス・ルネサンス音楽の中でも屈指の感情表現の深さを示した作曲家として、後世に高く評価されている。宮廷での不遇な境遇と、それを反映するかのような憂愁に満ちた作風は、芸術家の個人的な苦悩が創作にどう結びつくかを示す事例としてもしばしば語られる。
impact.en: In the genre of the lute song, he is highly regarded by later generations as a composer who achieved a depth of emotional expression unmatched within English Renaissance music. His difficult circumstances at court and the melancholic style that seems to mirror them are also often discussed as an example of how an artist's personal suffering can shape creative work.

ja: 常にダウランド、常に嘆くという標語
リュート歌曲における憂愁の表現
宮廷での不遇と作風の関係
en: Melancholic depth in the lute song
Court hardship reflected in his style
